(a) **Passive Element:** An electrical element that consumes or stores electrical energy without generating it (e.g., Resistor, Inductor, Capacitor).

(b) **Junction:** A point in a circuit where two or more circuit components or branches meet.

(c) **Unilateral Element:** An element whose $V-I$ characteristics are dependent on the direction of current flow (e.g., Diode, Transistor).

(d) **Ideal Source:** A theoretical voltage or current source that has zero internal resistance and provides constant voltage or current regardless of the load connected to it.
